papers.title: AniAMPpred: artificial intelligence guided discovery of novel antimicrobial peptides in animal kingdom
Antiprotozoal peptide prediction using machine learning with effective feature selection techniques
Geometric deep learning as a potential tool for antimicrobial peptide prediction
Antimicrobial peptide activity prediction using machine learning methods (Makine öğrenmesi yöntemleriyle antimikrobiyal peptit aktivite tahmini)

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Support Vector Machine with deep learning-based features
models.candidate_reason: AMP prediction model with SVM and deep features, online server available; abstract describes high accuracy and non-biased classification.
blocking_issues: fulltext provided does not match article (PMC12620532 is a different paper); only abstract evidence used

models.architecture_or_algorithm: XGBoost with mRMR feature selection on pfeature composition features
models.input_features: amino acid composition features (selected by mRMR)
models.candidate_reason: Predicts antiprotozoal peptides (AMP subclass) with high accuracy, provides web server, suitable for benchmarking.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Graph Attention Network (GAT) with features: one-hot, position encoding, PSSM, HMM, and structural contact maps
models.input_features: sequence features and structural graph-based features (predicted contact maps)
models.candidate_reason: Mentioned in review as outperforming current methods, based on geometric deep learning.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) with message passing, 9 physicochemical properties per amino acid, bond features
models.input_features: graph representation of peptide (physicochemical and bond properties)
models.candidate_reason: Review states it outperformed four other deep learning methods.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) on heterogeneous graph of amino acids, dipeptides, tripeptides
models.candidate_reason: Predicts lactic acid bacteria AMPs, outperformed other ML algorithms according to review.

repositories.name: Appred webserver
repositories.evidence: web server (www.soodlab.com/appred) to predict the antiprotozoal activity.

metrics.evidence: accuracy of 97.27 %, 93.64 %, 86.36 %, 90.91 %, and 89.09 % respectively on validation dataset
sensitivity values reported in multiple tables
AUCROC 0.99 for Appred; sAMPpred-GAT AuC mentioned

important_evidence: AniAMPpred: SVM with deep features, server at https://aniamppred.anvil.app/ (abstract evidence only)
Appred: XGBoost, mRMR feature selection, accuracy 97.27%, AUC 0.99, server www.soodlab.com/appred
sAMPpred-GAT, AMPs-Net, LABAMPs: mentioned in review, no original code or server found
uncertainties: AniAMPpred: The fulltext provided (PMC12620532) is a different article on AI and photodynamic therapy; the correct fulltext is needed to verify details.
sAMPpred-GAT, AMPs-Net, LABAMPs: Only review-level evidence; original papers must be located and assessed for code/data availability.
Turkish paper: No abstract or fulltext available; unclear if it describes a named model.
